properties.name: openapi.http-client.enable-debug-logging
properties.description: Whether to enable debug logging for HTTP requests and responses, including JSON body content.

properties.name: openapi.http-client.redacted-headers
properties.description: Collection of header names (case-insensitive) whose values will be redacted in debug logs. By default, Authorization and X-API-KEY headers are redacted for security.

properties.name: openapi.retry-config.backoff.base-factor
properties.description: The multiplier for exponential backoff. Each retry delay is multiplied by this factor (e.g., 1.5 means 50% increase).

properties.name: openapi.retry-config.backoff.initial-interval
properties.description: The initial delay before the first retry attempt. Supports duration formats like "500ms", "1s", "2m".

properties.name: openapi.retry-config.backoff.jitter-factor
properties.description: Random jitter factor to avoid thundering herd problems. Value between 0.0 (no jitter) and 1.0 (full jitter).

properties.name: openapi.retry-config.backoff.max-elapsed-time
properties.description: The maximum total time to spend on all retry attempts. Retries will stop after this duration.

properties.name: openapi.retry-config.backoff.max-interval
properties.description: The maximum delay between retry attempts. The backoff will not exceed this value.

properties.name: openapi.retry-config.backoff.retry-connect-error
properties.description: Whether to retry requests that fail due to connection errors (e.g., connection refused, timeout).

properties.name: openapi.retry-config.backoff.retry-read-timeout-error
properties.description: Whether to retry requests that fail due to read timeout errors (server doesn't respond within timeout).

properties.name: openapi.retry-config.strategy
properties.description: The retry strategy to use for failed requests.

properties.name: openapi.server-idx
properties.description: The index of the server to use from the list of available servers (0-based). Defaults to the first server.

properties.name: openapi.server-url
properties.description: The base URL for the API server. If not specified, the SDK will use the default server URL.
